name: guardrails-test-200
notes: Pins the probe contract with blocking off (the default): an email sample is flagged pii/email, the redacted text carries the placeholder, nothing would block, and nothing is recorded or sent upstream. The Go test additionally asserts the raw address appears nowhere in the response and the live guardrail store's counters are unchanged by the probe.
recorded_from: mock-upstream: no upstream exists for this endpoint — the handler runs the local guardrails scan only; recorded_response is the placeholder the harness schema requires, not a replayed upstream reply
